name: Proof card
description: A screenshot flies up into the lower middle as a card with a soft shadow and a slight 3D tilt, settles flat, gets a highlighter swipe over one area, then leaves. A small chip says 'Real numbers'.
when: When you say a result and have the screenshot to back it: a post, a tweet, an email, a dashboard, a review.
needs: the screenshot as a PNG (any size)
the area to highlight, in screenshot pixels (optional)
the cut time where it starts
